name: Prepositions & dependent prepositions
note: Many verbs, adjectives and nouns take a fixed preposition: depend on, good at, interested in, afraid of, listen to, wait for, arrive at/in. These have to be learned as whole chunks.

questions.fs: Just to let you know how I am getting on in my new job.
